scope: CPU-only historical complete RTG+Facility+Completion(.25) candidates for existing Qwen 10-task 3-budget table
selection_policy: Per-cell maximum among eligible complete same-model same-budget same-method runs. Native and legacy execution differences remain explicit. Current rounded STATUS values are not independent score candidates; exact corrected source scores supersede their rounding.

history_scan.excluded: DEV-100 pilot and fresh subsets; E_MAIN025/BASE/R_GATHER and all other arms; full keep-all; teacher/oracle; other benchmarks; wrong metrics; incorrect old scorer/GT variants

notes: K128/K64 have one complete legacy candidate each per task. No higher same-method same-budget native complete run was found.
Qwen MME is perception + cognition/reasoning total, not LLaVA perception only. Existing verified TSV chain was unaffected by the LLaVA 162-label incident.
HallusionBench uses fAcc with 346 figure groups over 951 prediction rows; aAcc and qAcc are excluded.
MMBench V11 uses 1292 circular groups over 4876 option-rotation rows; 1292 is not missing-data evidence.
Native K256 increases selected TV/Chart/DV/OCR/MMB-EN through different model execution; no method-improvement attribution to these increases.
